links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting (instructions only) of the same AI models, each evaluating all images five times
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and run-to-run reproducibility of osteoporosis classification on lumbar radiographs and CT
links.effect: Few-shot prompting with 20 labeled reference cases did not consistently improve AI accuracy, but reproducibility improved in several models, most notably Claude. No numeric values for the few-shot versus zero-shot differences are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Few-shot prompting may improve consistency without improving accuracy.

design_hint: few-shot prompting and combined physician-AI review
